Update

[Other Updates & Fixes]

 Fixed an issue where FOV settings were not applied when switching ADS
 Changed weapon icons

notes.title: Release Note!
notes.notes:
* Translated by DeepL

Grappling Gunners: Arena FPS has been released!
This is a work that I personally developed because I wanted to make my own competitive FPS.

You can move up, down, left, and right with the grapple, so I hope you enjoy gunfights while enjoying the feeling of movement.
You can fight while switching between 7 skills. Some skills are strong on their own, while others, like Wall Hack and Smoke, are strong when combined.

Guns can be switched between full-auto and single-shot, with varying power and rate of fire.
Try it out, especially if you operate a secondary with a single shot, as the power is much higher.

The server is hosted by one person, and other players join the server.
When you want to play with your friends for a while, you don't have to say "I can't play because there is no server! We hope you will feel free to try it out.
The capacity is about 600MB, so you don't have to worry even if your SSD is depleted!

I think we have fixed as many bugs as we can, but there is a high possibility that there are still unknown bugs, so we will fix them as soon as we find them.

If you are at all curious about the game, I would be happy if you could download it and try it at least at the shooting range!
I would be very happy if you could play it with your friends!

I would be very happy if you could play with your friends and see what they think!



- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
My name is Arutaka.
I'm a beginner who started game development as a hobby and have only been doing it for about a year.
If you are interested in developing with me, I would be happy to hear from you.
(I mainly use Unreal Engine, but I have made some novel games in other languages.)

I don't use twitter (X) or any other social networking services at this time, so if you would like to contact me individually, please use the Google Form below to contact me, and I will send you a Discord or email.
